name: La-Z-Boy Inc
recommendation: FLAT. Red's REJECT (8/10) and blue's FLAT (7/10) converge on outcome; blue's audit governs the reasoning. Red's accounting kills were largely artifacts: the lease-liability EV construction DOUBLE-COUNTS rent (ASC 842 runs straight-line rent through opex — capitalizing the liability against unadjusted earnings charges the dollar twice; adjudicator confirms as textbook), the OCF bridge omitted a one-time $11M pension-termination payment (returns/OCF = 1.3x not 2.2x), and the revenue/segment deltas were divestiture comps (organic -1%, Retail adj OM UP 20bp YoY). What survives is ABSENCE OF EDGE, not damage: a real-but-decelerating multi-year erosion (Q1 adj compression ~55bp), a bull with NO FY27 EPS of its own, and a street at PT ~$41 already holding the identical trough mechanism.
kill_class_census: 0 NOVEL / 4 CONSENSUS after audit (red's one novel kill — the lease EV — overturned)
named_kill: NO-DIVERGENCE (bull supplied no FV; street holds the trough mechanism) + the desk's 0-for-7 graded earnings-dislocation template. §CONSENSUS-KILL minimum-starter does NOT attach: no own-FV exists below which the tape sits (FA precedent — absent-pack governs).

price <=$28 (~9.4x street FY27) — asymmetry no longer needs a divergence
a bull FY27 EPS build >=$3.50 with named mechanism
csp_read_20260824: NOT AUTHORIZED: no ruled buy band exists (CSP = paid limit-buy; requires buy intention at strike). Chain also fails Template gate 3 — token OI (prior sweep: 'juicy on 58 IV but token OI + prints inside tenor'). The $28 level is a re-court trigger, never a strike.

pre_mortem: Tripwire-less (unknown-unknown: store-cohort economics): no instrument verifies whether the 234->450 buildout's incremental margin is accretive — the truth arrives in segment disclosures years after the rent is contracted.
The transformation charges genuinely stop in Q2 (three of five buckets are terminal events) and the clean print re-rates the stock before any trigger fires.
Reflexive: the 0-for-7 template prior is doing heavy lifting — if this is the setup that breaks the pattern, our prior is the error.
what_could_go_wrong.sentence: If this FLAT costs us, the most likely reason will be that the transformation charges actually stop in Q2 and the 450-store cohort inflects — the bull's facts were better than either bench argued, and we graded the silence instead of the store economics.
